title: Three.
paragraphs:
Because when God reaches “three”…
He’s not starting something.
You thought you still had time.

You thought you were “in process.”
You thought your hidden sin was still negotiable.
you’re already standing on your third moment?
Because in Scripture, three is not casual.
It is the line between delay… and decision.

He walked with Jesus.
Ate with Him.
Heard His voice.

That quiet conviction you keep silencing.
That habit you keep justifying.
That compromise you renamed as “normal.”
How many times has God already warned you?
Because in the Bible, three completes the testimony.

“A matter must be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses.”
— Deuteronomy 19:15
He kept running—until God allowed him to sink into the deep.

“And Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.”
— Jonah 1:17
“I will not let you destroy yourself in slow motion.”
Some of you are in that place right now.
Because He could have let you keep going.
And here’s where it gets heavier.
Jesus Himself stepped into the pattern of three.

“He is not here; He has risen, just as He said.”
— Matthew 28:6
This is the turning point of all history.
But here’s the part most people avoid.
then you don’t get to live like it’s unfinished.
You don’t get to hold onto sin like grace is cheap.
You don’t get to flirt with darkness and claim the light.

“Shall we continue in sin that grace may abound? By no means!”
— Romans 6:1–2
This is where it gets personal.
but your private life tells a different story.
And the tension is suffocating you.
Because conviction doesn’t let you rest.
And compromise doesn’t let you breathe.
Because if God wanted to condemn you—

“The Lord is not slow in keeping His promise… but is patient with you, not wanting anyone to perish, but everyone to come to repentance.”
— 2 Peter 3:9
And now He invites you into that finished work.

“If we confess our sins, He is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.”
— 1 John 1:9
This is where shame loses its grip.
But you are not promised endless delay either.
There is a moment when God says:
Because three is where decisions are sealed.
Because Jesus was not just forgiving him.
That means your story is not defined by your worst moment.
Because you don’t need another sign.
So let me ask you directly:
What are you still holding onto?
Jesus is not asking for perfection.
Because the same Jesus who walked out of the grave…
is standing at the door of your heart.

“Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears My voice and opens the door, I will come in…”
— Revelation 3:20
you are not a work in progress trying to earn love.
You are a redeemed soul learning to live from it.
If this stirred something deep in you…
